slots.frame: relative grid grid-rows-1 grid-cols-1 aspect-[var(--arena-ratio-frame,var(--arena-ratio,var(--aspect-media)))] overflow-hidden rounded-media border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] border-[color:var(--surfaces-media-sunken-edge-rest,var(--edge-surface))] bg-[color:var(--surfaces-media-sunken-fill-rest,var(--fill-surface-sunken))] text-[color:var(--surfaces-media-sunken-ink-rest,var(--ink-eyebrow))] shadow-surface-rest
slots.media: col-start-1 row-start-1 w-full h-full min-w-0 min-h-0 [&>img]:fit-media [&>img]:w-full [&>img]:h-full [&>video]:fit-media [&>video]:w-full [&>video]:h-full
slots.fallback: col-start-1 row-start-1 grid place-items-center w-full h-full
slots.overlay: col-start-1 row-start-1 self-end flex flex-wrap items-center gap-inline p-surface bg-[color:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--surfaces-media-fill-rest,var(--overlay-media))_var(--level-media),transparent)] text-[color:var(--surfaces-media-ink-rest,var(--ink-heading))]
slots.caption: font-body text-sm text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted) leading-prose m-0
